aboutSubheading: Delivering safe, quality electrical work since 2008
aboutText: Hadley Electrical has been proudly serving Melbourne and its surrounding suburbs for over 15 years, providing safe and reliable electrical solutions to homes, businesses and industrial sites. Our team of fully licensed electricians is committed to honest pricing, punctual service, and workmanship that meets the highest Australian standards. Whether it's a simple power point install or a complex commercial fit-out, we treat every job with the same level of care and professionalism.
servicesSubheading: Complete electrical solutions for every property type
servicesText: From minor repairs to major installations, Hadley Electrical delivers a full range of electrical services across Melbourne. Every job is completed by a licensed professional who puts safety and quality first.

services.title: Residential Electrical
services.desc: Complete home electrical services including rewiring, switchboard upgrades, power points, smoke alarms and safety inspections for Melbourne households.

services.title: Commercial Electrical
services.desc: Fit-outs, data cabling, lighting design, emergency exit signage and ongoing maintenance contracts for shops, offices and hospitality venues across Melbourne.

services.title: Industrial Electrical
services.desc: Heavy-duty electrical solutions for warehouses, factories and manufacturing plants including 3-phase power, machinery wiring and compliance testing.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Service
services.desc: Electrical emergencies don't wait and neither do we. Our on-call team is available around the clock for urgent faults, outages and safety hazards.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated switchboards are a serious safety risk. We upgrade old fuse boxes to modern circuit-breaker panels with RCD protection to keep your property compliant.

services.title: LED Lighting & Energy Saving
services.desc: Slash your energy bills with LED downlights, sensor lights and smart lighting solutions installed by our experienced team.
